prompt.original: Use `prioritizing-roadmap`. Product: Team collaboration SaaS. ICP: 10-200 person tech companies, team leads. Decision: Pick Q2 roadmap themes and top 8 initiatives in 2 weeks. North Star: weekly active teams completing >=1 project. Constraints: 6 engineers, 1 designer; must complete SSO launch; platform migration dependency in May. Stakeholders: Head of Product (decider), Eng Manager, Growth PM, CS lead. We have 15 candidate initiatives from backlog, customer requests, and internal ideas. Output: Roadmap Prioritization Pack.
